analysis.rationale: Consolidated PAT grew 156% YoY to ₹830 crore, and NBFC AUM surged 2.6x YoY to ₹30,667 crore, indicating strong operational momentum.
analysis.summary: Jio Financial Services reported Q1 FY27 consolidated total income of ₹1,496 crore (up 141% YoY) and PAT of ₹830 crore (up 156% YoY), driven by strong growth in lending, payments, and asset management.
